text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stage of the grand goal for Mejiro 
Umamusume, the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Overwhelmed by everyone's serious 
attitude, Mejiro Palmer can't make her 
party animal moves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Palmer sank under the crushing 
weight of pressure, the race got underway.
